name: PostgreSQL · Round 1
domainSummary: A relational database capability built around schemas and typed relations, ACID transactions, multiversion concurrency control, indexes and query planning, write-ahead logging, crash recovery, replication, and extensibility.
evidenceBoundary: Do not use elephant imagery, logos, SQL text, table grids, or generic database cylinders alone. Keep concurrency and recovery as structural features.

researchSources.title: PostgreSQL MVCC introduction
researchSources.use: Official snapshot isolation and nonblocking read-write concurrency model.

researchSources.title: PostgreSQL WAL introduction
researchSources.use: Official write-ahead logging, durability, and crash-recovery mechanism.
